judgment_refs.phrase: willfully to fail or refuse to comply with any lawful order or direction
judgment_refs.note: Original officer indication and subsequent subject motion are measurable; officer duty, order lawfulness and willfulness require independent source and legal review.

sweep_specs.rationale: Vary timed officer indication while preserving the selected crossing and pedestrian response; no legal inference.
missing_inputs: The three constructed early/nominal/late timing probes are boundary probes; a complete judgment_sweep still needs a frozen one-dimensional axis/grid, exact judgment_sweep cases, and matched source-backed measurements. Officer duty, lawful order and willfulness remain unresolved legal/context judgments.

cases.rationale: Shared intersection pedestrian and officer setup; no baseline legal result.
